send_event.description: Send a custom event to Dynatrace, such as a deployment marker, an annotation or an alert. Alert-type events open a problem.

parameters.description: What kind of event this is. Deployments, annotations and info events only show on charts and entity pages; the others open a problem.
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.description: The event's title.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Which entities the event belongs to, such as type("SERVICE"),entityName.equals("checkout"). Leave empty to attach it to the whole environment.

parameters.description: Extra details to keep on the event, as names and values.
parameters.name: properties

parameters.description: When the event starts. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description: When the event ends. Defaults to the start plus the time-out.
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description: How long the event stays open without being sent again, 1 to 360. Dynatrace's default is 15.
parameters.name: timeout_minutes

correlation_id.description: Dynatrace's correlation ID for the new event

status.description: OK, or why Dynatrace did not create it
